text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Critical — Smart routing fallback loop detected for customer acme-corp. Data residency policy violation: requests served from eu-west-1 while customer is locked to us-east-1. Error rate spiked + customer reported PII leakage risk. Please acknowledge and join #incidents immediately.

alex_m: acked. jumping in. @priya_s can you pull the routing decision logs for acme-corp? we need to know why fallback picked eu-west-1.

priya_s: on it. pulling logs now: `routing_decisions/2026-03-15/176900` — preliminary: health check for us-east-1 returned transient 503s for model-variant rtx-q8_8, fallback policy allowed cross-region fallback to eu-west-1.

mike_r: that's a hard violation for acme-corp (data_residency=us-only). sounds like fallback policy didn't include residency guard. paging security/compliance now.

emma_cs: acme-corp support pinged with "we see responses from eu-west-1 IPs" and asked to pause traffic. customer is on enterprise contract with strict residency clause.

alex_m: immediate mitigation plan: 1) disable cross-region fallback for any customer with data_residency!=any 2) re-route in-flight requests to us-east-1 dedicated pool (even if degraded) 3) notify customer + open compliance ticket. can someone apply 1) as a temporary policy rollback?

priya_s: making a config change to routing-policy service: applying temp block rule `deny: cross_region_fallback where customer.data_residency != 'any'` — will push to canary region first, then global. doing global push now.

ops-bot: deploy started: routing-policy-v2 -> canary -> global (dry-run disabled)

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Policy change acknowledged by platform. Deploy in progress.

priya_s: global push complete. verifying decisions... seeing new evaluations route to us-east-1.

alex_m: good. next: how many requests already served from eu-west-1? we need scope for data exfil risk and customer notification text.

priya_s: quick query: `select count(*) from requests where customer_id='acme' and region='eu-west-1' and ts > now() - interval '30 minutes'` -> 1,872 requests. extracting sample headers/ids for audit.

mike_r: 1,872 is non-trivial. need to check payload sensitivity. start a preservation snapshot of logs and KV cache for eu-west-1 nodes. I'll open an evidence bucket and set retention.

emma_cs: I'm drafting the initial outreach: short, apologetic, what we know, mitigation steps, timeline, and offer for deep audit. pinging legal and account team.

alex_m: ops: can we stop the eu-west-1 inference nodes from accepting new acme traffic while keeping them online for forensic reads?

ops-bot: applied ACL tag to eu-west-1 nodes: `block:customer:acme-corp` — new connections from acme token will be rejected. Existing in-flight sessions remain readable.

priya_s: replayed routing decisions for a few IDs — fallback decision came after a cascade: model variant rtx-q8_8 reported OOM on 3 hosts -> health check marked capacity=0 -> fallback logic used compatibility map and chose eu-west-1 rtx-q8_8 replica. The residency guard (should have) been in route_selector but was not evaluated because of a priority bug in policy engine v1.9.

mike_r: notes for postmortem: policy engine bug likely regression introduced in v1.9 that re-ordered evaluation predicates. Marking SEC_HIGH.

alex_m: oncall handoff in 20m: @priya_s you'll keep remediation, I'll start drafting the incident summary and timeline. @emma_cs you own customer comms. @mike_r you own evidence collection & legal sync.

priya_s: ack. I'll keep monitoring and run an emergency canary of the policy change to ensure no other customers affected.

ops-bot: canary checks: all enterprise-locked customers reported route enforcement OK.

incident-bot: Reminder: please include SRE pager rotation for follow-up tasks. Oncall rotation: priya_s (current) -> alex_m (handoff) at 16:40 UTC.

alex_m: handoff accepted. taking over at 16:40 UTC. priya, leave me the query snippets and any outstanding runs.

priya_s: dropping snippets: 
```
-- routing audit
select request_id, routed_region, route_step, policy_version from routing_logs
where customer_id='acme' and ts between '2026-03-15 16:00:00' and now();
```
and the policy change diff is in: `git:infra/routing-policy@a3f2d` (temporary deny rule).

mike_r: evidence bucket created `forensic/acme/1769001234` with logs, kv-dumps, and node snapshots. set retention to 90 days. legal_contact@redwood copied.

emma_cs: sent initial message to acme-corp support and account team. we'll offer a call in 60 minutes. queued follow-up with remediation timeline and offer for independent audit.

alex_m: next: permanent fix — either reintroduce residency guard into policy engine evaluation ordering OR add a fast-fail check pre-routing. we should stop relying on predicate order. @mike_r can you propose compliance-safe defaults?

mike_r: propose: 1) introduce pre-routing validation plugin that runs before any fallback decisions; 2) add stricter e2e tests that simulate regional failures and assert residency invariants; 3) ship a patch to policy engine to enforce predicate commutativity.

priya_s: created JIRA INC-3491 for bug + INC-3492 for tests + INC-3493 for pre-routing plugin. assigning to eng-runtime and eng-sre.

ops-bot: config audit: other customers with data_residency=us-only -> no violations detected.

incident-bot: Status update: Mitigated — cross-region fallback disabled for restricted customers, acme traffic is routing to us-east-1. Forensic data preserved. Customer notified and call scheduled.

emma_cs: note for postmortem: likely to include compensation discussions. account team alerted.

alex_m: closing steps: 1) run full export for legal, 2) finalize customer note, 3) schedule blameless postmortem with eng-runtime/policy/security. I'll file the incident report after the handoff.

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Incident recorded as P0-1769001234. Please add timeline and channel logs to the incident ticket.

alex_m: thanks everyone. if anything changes ping me directly. I'll update the incident ticket in 30m with final timeline.

emma_cs: adding the support transcript and customer contact notes to the ticket now.

priya_s: leaving monitoring on. will follow up if new anomalies show up. handing off oncall to alex_m at 16:40 UTC.

alex_m: taking over. closing thread for new updates — continue in the incident ticket.
